survey: An orange round clock stands upright on its rim on a flat green floor, in front of a green striped wall. The camera is at about the clock's centre height, a little above the floor. You can see the floor recede to a horizon line, and the clock casts a soft, flat oval shadow. The clock is turned slightly. You can see a sliver of the rim's thickness along its left and lower-left edge. The outer rim is a slightly upright oval, about 795 px wide by 845 px tall. The white face inside it is narrowed by about the same amount (about 640 by 675 px), so the rim and face agree on one angle. The 12 hour markers and the minute dots are evenly spaced around the face and point to its centre. The hour hand points to about 10 and the minute hand to about 2, and both start at a centre hub that sits at the centre of the face. The red second hand comes out of the same hub. The rim's bottom meets the floor at one low point, and the shadow spreads out flat along the floor, which matches the slightly-from-above view of the ground. The floor-to-wall line and the wall stripes stay horizontal and vertical, so they agree with a camera that is not tilted.
